forbid: the blog on the same server belongs to another team — do not touch its process, vhost or certificate
deploys never run database migrations; migrations are applied separately after a backup

targets.app: Next.js, PM2 process example-web, 2 instances on port 3000

trigger.who: any push to main; by hand: gh workflow run deploy.yml

flags.AUTO_DEPLOY: unset (gh variable get AUTO_DEPLOY: not found) => off, push only builds

steps: npm ci + tests + next build on the runner
upload the build, swap it in atomically, keep the previous one
pm2 reload, health check, roll back on failure

rollback.how: a failed health check restores the previous build; afterwards a person can swap back with one command
